label: Unload LM Studio Model
description: Unloads a specific model from LM Studio to free memory. Use the exact identifier as reported by the model list (repeated loads without unloading can create numbered duplicate instances, e.g. "model-name:2").

args.name: model
args.label: Model identifier (exact, e.g. prism-ml/bonsai-27b or prism-ml/bonsai-27b:2)
